Where these reports come from
Non Amazon Reports
Operational performance — typed in each month Vendor Central → Performance → Operational performance, viewed by month: the four defect rates and the chargeback each cost. Rates as plain numbers, the % is already there (3.56 means 3.56%; N/A or blank where there is none); charges in dollars. Pick any day of the month — the reading counts in that month. Older months load as a sheet (CSV or workbook) with a Date column and the same headings; what is on file is listed below with the other files. Save to the site publishes them like everything else.

DSP spend — typed in for a month What Amazon DSP cost for a month. It is shared out evenly over the month's days — a week takes its days' share — and counts in Ad spend and TACOS (not in ACOS or cost per click, which are the sponsored ads' own). Under Ad spend and Plan ad spend the report says how much of it is DSP. Typing a month again replaces it. Save to the site publishes it.

Inbound cover target

Browse the data

Everything this page holds, one kind at a time, as a table: filter on any word, narrow to a span of dates, sort by a column, and download the rows you are looking at. The same columns as the files above, so what you download here loads back in.

What is loaded

A file stops being a file the moment it is read — its numbers are folded into the page. So this is not a list of uploads but a list of what they left behind, and removing a line here is how an upload is undone. Re-loading the same span simply replaces it, so this is only needed when a span was wrong.
